# Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup

# Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup — concept pack

> Source-anchored research for Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup. Run status: COMPLETED.

## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup (33/1)

## Definitions

- [statement] The original transaction number is a mapping sanity check, not an instruction to replace each pooled session’s own transaction number. Splitting an already tracked session fails an invariant; lookup, split-status checking and release require the original transaction number to remain unchanged. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp

## Structure and components

- [statement] `SplitPrepareSessionManager` maps a top-level logical session ID to its original transaction number and a vector of `SplitSessionInfo`; each split record contains a pooled session and a `requesterId`. `splitSession` acquires a system session from the internal pool for each requester. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager.h · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager.cpp
- [statement] PreparedTxnSplitTest contains MultiplePrepareTxnsInSameBatch and SingleEmptyPrepareTransaction fixtures that construct writer vectors and assert split prepare/terminal instructions and reused pooled identities across batches. These are source-defined assertions. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] Initial-sync dispatch skips prepare entries and, on a prepared commit, sends the transaction-chain operations to writer vectors. The transaction application layer therefore marks direct initial-sync prepare and commit application unreachable; initial-sync abort returns success because transactions are not placed into prepared state until the end of initial sync. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_dispatch.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp

## How it works

- [statement] `_getCommittedStmtIds` collects operation statement IDs only when `isInternalSessionForRetryableWrite` holds. `_applyPrepareTransaction` uses supplied statement IDs or derives them from its own operation list, then calls `txnParticipant.addCommittedStmtIds`; its comment says these IDs prevent re-executing committed statements after the node becomes primary. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] For mapped terminal work, addDerivedCommitsOrAborts emits one applySplitPreparedTxnOp per saved pooled session and also adds a top-level terminal instruction. It selects the current writer index with sessInfo.requesterId modulo the current writer-vector size to remain in bounds when the count has changed. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] Recovery-mode prepare application returns without applying operations until a commit entry or the end of recovery. Initial-sync prepare and commit dispatch are unreachable because committed operations are unpacked separately. Abort dispatch returns success during recovery and initial sync because the transactions have not yet been put into the prepared state. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] In stable and unstable recovery, `applyPrepareTransaction` returns success without applying the prepare operations until a commit is seen or recovery ends. `applyCommitTransaction` uses `_applyTransactionFromOplogChain`, while `applyAbortTransaction` returns success because transactions are not put into prepared state until recovery ends. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The prepare retry body resets prepare-conflict behavior on the recovery unit, installs an error guard that aborts the transaction and invalidates its participant, unstashes transaction resources, applies operations and prepares. Success dismisses the guard and stashes resources. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] The prepare retry body resets prepare-conflict behavior and, for recovery or initial sync, enables prepared-timestamp rounding. Its error guard calls `txnParticipant.abortTransaction` and `txnParticipant.invalidate` so a write-conflict retry can release transaction resources; on success it prepares at the oplog entry’s operation time, dismisses the guard, and stashes transaction resources. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] The manager’s source death fixtures are `SplitAlreadySplitSessions`, `ReleaseNonSplitSessions`, and `ChangeTxnNumberAfterSessionSplit`; they attempt duplicate splitting, release of an untracked session, and release with a changed transaction number, respectively, expecting an invariant failure. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager.cpp

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Terminal split assignment computes `sessInfo.requesterId % writerVectors->size()` before indexing the writer vectors. The comment explicitly allows the worker count to change after prepare; this is an in-bounds remapping, rather than a promise to preserve physical thread identity. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup

## Facts and statements

- [statement] For a nonempty prepare with serial assignment disabled, `addDerivedPrepares` buffers operation pointers by the result of `getWriterId`, collects requester IDs in an ordered set, acquires one split session for each occupied writer vector, and emits an `applySplitPreparedTxnOp` carrying the original prepare entry, that pooled session, and the writer’s operation subset. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.h
- [statement] An empty prepare still acquires a split session: `addDerivedPrepares` chooses a writer from the original prepare entry, whose namespace is described as `admin.$cmd`, and emits `applySplitPreparedTxnOp` with an empty operation vector. Its comment states that this preserves the secondary-mode invariant that all prepares are split. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.h
- [statement] With serial assignment requested for a nonempty prepare, the first derived operation selects the writer and all derived operations enter that writer’s buffer; one pooled split session is allocated for that selected writer. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.h
- [statement] `addTopLevelPrepare` uses `getWriterIdBySessionId` with the original prepare entry and emits `applyTopLevelPreparedTxnOp` carrying the full `*derivedOps` list. The prepare-assignment call site explains retaining the original `TransactionParticipant` state for a later transition to primary. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp
- [statement] applySplitPreparedTxnOp prepares with the pooled session ID, pooled transaction number and copied operation subset. applyTopLevelPreparedTxnOp instead uses the original session ID and transaction number, passes an empty operations array, and extracts committed statement IDs from the full transaction operations for retryable internal transactions. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] Prepare application checks out the chosen session through `checkOutSessionWithoutRefresh` inside `writeConflictRetryWithLimit`. The source explains that refreshing from disk could read a concurrently applied transaction-table write and interfere with the existing transaction number. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] For terminal work, addDerivedCommitsOrAborts looks up the original session and transaction number. If no split mapping exists, it adds the original operation without splitting; its comment identifies prior preparation as primary or during initial sync/recovery as examples. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] Secondary commit and abort application accept `applyOplogEntry` or `applyTopLevelPreparedTxnOp` only without a sub-session, and use the original session ID and transaction number. `applySplitPreparedTxnOp` requires a sub-session and uses its pooled identity. Both terminal paths require `op.preparedTxnOps` to be absent. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] The secondary commit and abort helpers install their chosen identity with the terminal entry’s retry counter, use `checkOutSessionWithoutRefresh`, and unstash the participant. Commit calls `txnParticipant.commitPreparedTransaction` with the parsed commit timestamp and terminal operation time; abort calls `txnParticipant.abortTransaction`. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] Batch terminal cleanup follows `_workerPool->waitForIdle()` and the worker-status loop. A non-OK worker status returns before the release loop. After that barrier, prepared commit/abort entries with tracked mappings call `releaseSplitSessions`, which returns each pooled session to the pool and erases the top-level mapping. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager.cpp
- [statement] The limited reason for retaining top-level state is future usability of the original session: the older replication README says its in-memory state must be set correctly on step-up for new transaction commands. At the development pin, the assignment code likewise retains top-level prepare and terminal instructions for a later transition to primary. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/b41cda4fe697dce6fd9b83b3805362ccc02fbeb3/src/mongo/db/repl/README.md · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp
- [statement] SplitPrepareSessionManagerTest source asserts unique split session IDs, preserved requester IDs, lookup and split-status behavior after release, and release-all cleanup. Its death fixtures cover splitting an already split session, releasing a nonsplit session and changing the transaction number at release. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] The source fixture `SinglePreparedTxnMultipleOpsOnOneDoc` creates two document IDs selected for different writer IDs and three operations per document: insert, update, and delete. Its assertions require two split transactions, each containing only one document’s three operations, and require each later commit to reuse its prepare sub-session ID. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] The older b41cda4 replication README describes terminal splitting to the same threads. The e37ae17 implementation instead explicitly allows the worker count to change and applies modulo remapping; SERVER-115359 describes the cross-batch worker-count assumption that required attention. These descriptions have different revision scope. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/b41cda4fe697dce6fd9b83b3805362ccc02fbeb3/src/mongo/db/repl/README.md · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp, https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-115359
- [statement] For steady-state secondary prepare entries, the dispatcher reads transaction operations with `readTransactionOperationsFromOplogChainAndCheckForCommands` and passes the resulting operations and serialization flag to `addDerivedPrepares`; secondary prepared commit/abort entries enter `addDerivedCommitsOrAborts`. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_dispatch.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] `splitSession` requires a nonempty requester list and a previously unsplit top-level session. For a tracked mapping, `getSplitSessions`, `isSessionSplit`, and `releaseSplitSessions` require the supplied transaction number to equal the stored top-level transaction number; release also requires the mapping to exist. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager.h
- [statement] Split prepare application uses the pooled session’s own logical session ID and transaction number. Top-level prepare application uses the original oplog entry’s logical session ID and transaction number. Both reach `_applyPrepareTransaction`, which installs the chosen identity and the prepare entry’s transaction retry counter on the operation context. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/transaction_oplog_application.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] For a secondary terminal entry, `addDerivedCommitsOrAborts` looks up the original session and transaction number. If no split mapping exists, it adds the entry unchanged; the comment identifies transactions prepared while primary or during initial sync/recovery as non-split cases. With a mapping, it emits one split terminal instruction per pooled session and adds a top-level terminal instruction. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] The source fixture `SplitSessionsBasic` checks split-session ID uniqueness within each returned vector, requester-ID preservation, lookup and split-status results, and disappearance after per-session release. `SplitSessionsAndReleaseAll` checks that release-all removes tracked mappings. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/split_prepare_session_manager_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] The source fixture `MultiplePrepareTxnsInSameBatch` builds two prepared transactions, checks distinct split-session IDs for the transactions on each writer, and builds a subsequent commit for one transaction and abort for the other. It checks that the terminal instructions reuse their corresponding prepare sub-session IDs and omit operation subsets. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
- [statement] The source fixture `SingleEmptyPrepareTransaction` checks one split prepare with an empty operation list and a later split commit on the same writer using the same sub-session ID; it also checks that each phase has a top-level instruction. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned secondary prepared-transaction split-session application and terminal cleanup
